design: caller-only inline-source diagnostic, not a complete host/merger replay
cost_guard: Stop before next call if API-equivalent cumulative estimate >= USD 2; reserve USD 1 for a single in-flight call. This is not an invoice cap; CLI exposes no hard monetary cap.
stop: Any incomplete process, invalid coverage, unexpected tool use, source mutation, disputed supplied premise or missing usage stops batch. No conclusions before output inspection. If A never reproduces, localization inconclusive.
grading: Original read/F1 label and full reason fidelity; K excluded and M confirmed controls. Other original findings have no complete gold labels. No aggregate accuracy or held-out generalization.
